Lena (PM): Quick thought 1: let reviewers edit scorecard weights inline from the regression list (no modal). Saves a click for small tuning. Mock: https://figma.com/inline-edit-compact
Marco (Design): Sounds good. My concern: adding controls will increase visual noise. Proposal: show a compact "edit" pencil that expands an in-place mini-form (sliders + comment) in the score peek.
Priya (Frontend): Implementation: we can reuse the existing scorecard component. Prefer optimistic updates + an undo toast. Limit edits to runs with status=REVIEW.
Sam (A11y): A11y notes: expanded inline editor must trap focus and expose role=dialog. Buttons need descriptive aria-labels ("save score edits", "cancel edit"). Announce save result via aria-live.
Rex (QA): Need audit metadata: who edited, timestamp, and pre/post snapshot. Also surface delta (+/-) next to score after save. For bulk approvals, exclude edited tests until reviewer confirms.
Lena (PM): Good point on audit. Also add a tiny "changes affect approval" badge if the edit crosses the acceptance threshold. Default threshold stays admin-configurable.
Marco (Design): I'll make the editor microcopy minimal: Save / Cancel. Add micro-legend for delta color + textual +/- sign.
Priya (Frontend): Backend: POST /runs/:id/scorecard-edits -> returns {pre, post, affected_gate:true/false}. Frontend will show toast "Score saved (undo)" with 8s undo.
bot-ci: job queued: snapshot-compare/1765550000 -> https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1765550000
Sam (A11y): Keyboard shortcuts: E = toggle inline edit, Enter = save, Esc = cancel. Add tests with NVDA. Also ensure color-not-only cues for deltas.
Rex (QA): Edge case: concurrent edits -> show a small banner: "Scorecard changed by X. Review changes?" with keep/merge options.
Lena (PM): Plan: Marco + Priya prototype this week, Sam write A11y checklist, Rex add test cases, I'll update RFC. Quick sync tomorrow 10am. :white_check_mark:
